what: HIGH (code audit CA-A05-002, MEASURED 2026-09-27): the M28 design doc (docs/research/M28-macro-value-speculation-DESIGN.md:10-13) states P2 (event resolver + store + calendar feed) is "DONE", but no production code path anywhere in the repo calls event_store.write_events / write_event_links / resolve_all, or macro_signals.write_signals / make_signal, outside their own module and tests. No macro_events.jsonl / macro_signals.jsonl / thesis_event_links.jsonl exists anywhere in comms/macro/ (which has 26 other producer outputs). thesis_tick.py:130-137 (the only production entrypoint, called from src/main.py:1153-1154) never passes watched_events_by_symbol or signal_ids_by_symbol into form_theses_from_reads. Every thesis the live tick has ever formed carries watched_events=[] and signals=[] (thesis_engine.py defaults). The event-resolver DSL, event_store, and macro_signals store are fully built and unit-tested in isolation but have zero producer and zero consumer in production -- built but never wired, contradicting the design doc's DONE status. FIX: either wire econ_calendar_data.py's parsed events into event_store.write_events and thread watched_events_by_symbol/signal_ids_by_symbol through thesis_tick, or correct the design doc's status to "built, not wired" so a future session does not assume this join is live. Full finding: docs/audits/code-audit-2026-09-27/CA-A05.findings.jsonl id CA-A05-002.
